Requirements:

  • Linux x86_64, X11 or Wayland (through XWayland)
  • glibc 2.39 or newer (Ubuntu 24.04+, Debian 13+, Fedora 40+, Arch current)
  • ALSA runtime (libasound.so.2)
  • zenity or kdialog for the “save changes?” prompt (optional)

Install without root:

  • install -Dm755 lemonstudio ~/.local/bin/lemonstudio
  • install -Dm644 lemonstudio.png ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/lemonstudio.png
  • install -Dm644 lemonstudio.desktop ~/.local/share/applications/lemonstudio.desktop
